stack: TanStack Start (React 19) + Vite + Nitro/Cloudflare; Django REST API + SQLite
site_type: Government portal / local office hybrid + content (notices, publications)

items.name: Page purpose / one topic
items.evidence: Public routes have clear topics (jobs, contact, notices, pages/$slug). Homepage is portal hub by design.

items.name: SEO basics
items.evidence: Most public routes set title + description via TanStack head(); copy is topical.

items.name: AEO answer-first
items.evidence: No definition/answer-first blurb or FAQ UI on home or key service pages (web/src/routes/index.tsx).

items.name: GEO / citable entities
items.evidence: NAP in footer/header but no centralized entity config or citable org blurb for AI citation.

items.name: Crawling / internal discovery
items.evidence: Nav OK (web/src/data/site.ts); footer Important Links use href="#" (site-footer.tsx) — not crawlable.

items.name: Indexing readiness
items.evidence: No noindex on public pages, but /admin is not disallowed via robots and has no robots noindex meta.

items.name: robots.txt
items.evidence: web/public/robots.txt allows all crawlers but omits Sitemap: and Disallow: /admin.

items.name: sitemap.xml
items.evidence: No sitemap.xml in public/ and no generated route; Django has no sitemap view.

items.name: JSON-LD present
items.evidence: No application/ld+json anywhere under web/src.

items.name: Schema.org types
items.evidence: No Organization/GovernmentOffice/Article/FAQ/BreadcrumbList schema.

items.name: Structured data validity
items.evidence: None to validate.

items.name: Rich results honesty
items.evidence: No fabricated Review/AggregateRating schema present.

items.name: Breadcrumbs
items.evidence: PageBar label only; no BreadcrumbList UI/schema on nested routes.

items.name: Canonical URL
items.evidence: No rel=canonical or alternates.canonical; no SITE_URL config.

items.name: Meta title
items.evidence: Per-route titles on index, jobs, contact, content, pages, etc.

items.name: Meta description
items.evidence: Per-route descriptions present on major public pages.

items.name: Headings / single H1
items.evidence: Homepage (index.tsx) has no H1 — only SectionTitle as h2. Inner pages generally have one H1.

items.name: Keywords natural
items.evidence: Foreign employment / labour approval terms appear naturally in titles and copy.

items.name: Internal links
items.evidence: Nav linked well; footer links dead (#); limited in-body contextual links.

items.name: External refs
items.evidence: Few authoritative outbound citations beyond service URLs; footer gov links not wired.

items.name: Backlinks
items.evidence: Manual PR/partnership strategy only.

items.name: Page speed
items.evidence: lazy loading on some images; Vite code-splitting via router. Residual: large homepage.

items.name: Mobile friendly
items.evidence: Responsive Tailwind layouts, viewport meta in __root.tsx.

items.name: HTTPS absolute URLs
items.evidence: No VITE_SITE_URL / canonical https base for OG/canonical.

items.name: CWV hygiene
items.evidence: width/height on emblem/gallery images; font-display via Google Fonts CSS.

items.name: Image filenames
items.evidence: Assets under web/src/assets use descriptive names (nepal-emblem, gallery-*).

items.name: Alt text
items.evidence: Some content emblem imgs use alt="" on homepage; gallery has alts.

items.name: Open Graph
items.evidence: og:title/description on pages; missing og:image, og:url, absolute URLs.

items.name: Twitter Card
items.evidence: Root has twitter:card only; missing twitter:title/description/image per page.

items.name: FAQ schema
items.evidence: No FAQ UI or FAQPage JSON-LD.

items.name: Organization schema
items.evidence: No Organization/GovernmentOrganization JSON-LD in layout.

items.name: LocalBusiness / Gov office
items.evidence: Local NAP exists in UI; no LocalBusiness/GovernmentOffice schema with geo/hours.

items.name: Product schema
items.evidence: Not e-commerce.

items.name: Review schema
items.evidence: No review system; correctly absent.

items.name: Article schema
items.evidence: content/$id notices lack Article JSON-LD despite article og:type.

items.name: Video schema
items.evidence: Gallery AV albums are photo counts, not video players.

items.name: Search Console
items.evidence: No verification meta slot in site config; submit steps not documented in-repo.

items.name: Analytics
items.evidence: No GA/Plausible hooks or consent-aware placeholder.

items.name: EEAT
items.evidence: Contact, team, about pages, officials listed with roles.

items.name: Helpful content
items.evidence: Services, jobs, notices, downloads serve real citizen tasks.

items.name: Freshness
items.evidence: Content dates displayed; Django Content.published_at / updated_at models.

items.name: Topical authority
items.evidence: Category hubs for acts, notices, agencies, labour approval.

items.name: Entity SEO
items.evidence: Brand naming inconsistent across strings; no single seo/site config source of truth.

items.name: Semantic SEO
items.evidence: Home lacks related-concept sections (what DoFE does, how labour approval works).

items.name: Content clusters
items.evidence: Nav hub→category→content graph exists.

items.name: URL structure
items.evidence: Hyphenated lowercase routes (/contact-us, /services-list, /category/$slug).

items.name: Image/video sitemaps
items.evidence: Media volume modest; main sitemap sufficient if present.

items.name: IndexNow
items.evidence: No publish ping hook; CMS publish path has no IndexNow.

notes: Recon: monorepo with web (FE) + server (Django BE).
Site type agents: T-LOCAL (gov office NAP) + T-CONTENT (notices/articles).
Production domain assumed https://www.dofe.gov.np based on email/branding; confirm SITE_URL.
